categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, this PR documents the libbitcoinkernel C API callback contract, which is explicitly excluded from the Validation category.
categories.rationale: The Validation category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API. This PR is a 4-line documentation change to a libbitcoinkernel C API header clarifying that btck_WriteBytes may receive a null pointer when size is zero.
